purpose: See whether mutant deliver_3 exploitation grows, fades, or depends on normal pretraining, entropy, and width

phases.A: width 512, entropy 0.005, pretrain updates 0/128/512, fixed and mutant, 30 cells
phases.B: width 512, pretrain update 512, entropy 0.002 and 0.01, fixed and mutant, 20 cells
phases.C: width 256 and 1024, entropy 0.005, pretrain update 512, fixed and mutant, 20 cells

baseline_for_B_and_C: phase A width 512, pretrain 16777216 transitions, entropy 0.005
primary_metric: On the mutant evaluation environment, violation_delivery_rate of the mutant-adapted policy minus the same rate of the fixed-continued policy. All science checkpoints are kept. The best checkpoint is not selected.
per_update_metrics: updates.jsonl stores each update's own aggregates. A printed violation count is that update, not a cumulative total and not a first-discovery time.
resume: The latest adapt_{k} checkpoint restores parameters, optimizer, RNG, and worker state. The per-update log is trimmed to that checkpoint. Training does not return to adapt_0.
single_use: One violation delivery in an episode can reduce the number of harvests deliver_3 needs. Absence of a repeat inside the episode is not itself evidence that exploitation is weak.
holdout: Seeds 0-4 are the exploration set. A selected conclusion is confirmed later on new seeds.
pretraining: Width 512 seeds 0-2 reuse workshop12 base checkpoints. Width 512 seeds 3-4 and widths 256 and 1024 are pretrained in this run directory before their adaptation cells.
